# ifood-mcp-unofficial

Unofficial local-first MCP for personal iFood (Brazil). Not Partners merchant-api.

Install:
- npx -y ifood-mcp-unofficial setup
- npx -y ifood-mcp-unofficial auth start --email you@email.com
- npx -y ifood-mcp-unofficial auth complete --code <otp> --email you@email.com
- npx -y ifood-mcp-unofficial doctor

Stdio (never set IFOOD_ALLOW_MUTATIONS in the snippet):
{ "mcpServers": { "ifood": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "ifood-mcp-unofficial"] } } }

Default: read-only. Never pays.
Charge only if IFOOD_ALLOW_MUTATIONS is enabled AND explicit_user_intent is true.
Redacts street, phone, email, last-four.

Hosts: marketplace.ifood.com.br (profile/orders), cw-marketplace.ifood.com.br (cart), wsloja (checkout).

HTTP optional: loopback 127.0.0.1 + Origin allowlist. Tokens in ~/.ifood-mcp/tokens.json (0600).
